opening.quote: Good afternoon, tide well Home, you're speaking with just. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent greeted the caller and named the company, but did not clearly give a full personal name (only "just" was said), so the opening is only partly compliant.

verification.quote: Right, that went to 14 Prinsengracht, 1015 AE Amsterdam, delivered on tuesdays.
verification.comment: The agent shared the delivery address after getting only an order number; the caller's full name was never confirmed before order data was disclosed.

understanding.quote: So the shade is cracked and you'd like a replacement rather than a refund?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and confirmed the caller's preferred resolution without re-asking for details already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: A free replacement lamp is on its way and arrives in 2 to 1 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says replacements arrive in 2 to 4 working days, so the stated range of 2 to 1 is wrong and should have been 2 to 4.

process_compliance.quote: Can you email us a photo of the cracked shade first?
process_compliance.comment: The agent correctly asked for a photo before arranging the replacement and emailed a return label, but the item is €39.95 (over €25) so the free label step applied; the agent did follow it, though the caller was never asked permission before a hold, which did not occur, so the steps were followed.

communication.quote: I'm really upset, it was a birthdays present.
communication.comment: The caller said they were upset, but the agent never acknowledged the frustration or apologised, which the scorecard requires.

closing.quote: You'll get the tracking link by a email tomorrow. Anything else I can help with today?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if there was anything else, but the closing was abrupt and the return instructions were not clearly confirmed.
